steps.title: Two curves
steps.say: Demand slopes down: the lower the price, the more buyers want. Supply slopes up: the higher the price, the more sellers offer.

steps.title: Where they cross
steps.say: The equilibrium is where the curves cross. At price 5 the quantity buyers want equals the quantity sellers offer, which is 5.

steps.title: Price above equilibrium
steps.say: If the price is above 5, sellers offer more than buyers want. The surplus pushes the price down until it reaches 5.

steps.title: Price below equilibrium
steps.say: If the price is below 5, buyers want more than sellers offer. The shortage pushes the price up until it reaches 5.

steps.title: Quiz: supply falls
steps.say: Supply falls by 2 steps, so the supply curve moves left. Drag the dot to where you think the new equilibrium is.
